name: Fondo de Protección Ambiental: Proyectos Sustentables Ciudadanos

summary: Annual Chilean environment ministry contest giving 6 million pesos to community organisations and NGOs for local environmental projects, with biodiversity conservation as one of five thematic lines alongside water, waste and energy.
